cues.zh: 今天我们来看一栋房子是怎么建起来的！
cues.en: Today we came to watch a house get built!

cues.zh: Toyota Home在工厂里造好房屋单元，然后用卡车运过来。
cues.en: Toyota home builds house units at their factories and ships them by truck.

cues.zh: 在现场组装这些单元只需要一天。
cues.en: Assembling the units on site takes only one day.

cues.zh: 一位工人说，把房子拼起来其实只花大约6小时。
cues.en: One worker said it actually only takes about 6 hours to put the house together.

cues.zh: 过程之所以这么快，是因为他们在工厂里造好一个个单元，
cues.en: The process is so quick because they build the individual units in a factory

cues.zh: 零件可以放在室内，不受雨淋和其他天气影响。
cues.en: where the parts can stay indoors and out of the rain and other elements.

cues.zh: 我上学那会儿，有一次发现家附近突然冒出一栋房子，
cues.en: Once when I was a student, I noticed a house had appeared suddenly in my neighborhood

cues.zh: 就是我白天在学校的时候。
cues.en: while I was away during the day at school.

cues.zh: 一开始我以为这房子质量肯定不怎么样，但事实恰恰相反。
cues.en: At first, I thought the house must be poor quality but it was actually opposite.

cues.zh: 他们造这些房子花的功夫让我惊叹。
cues.en: I was amazed at how much effort they put into creating these houses.
Thank you for letting us shoot today.
Thank you very much for today.
